author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
We test and tear down Valve's new Steam Controller, the first of three Steam hardware devices releasing this year. Here's how it compares with the original Steam Controller released a decade ago, how the gyro and trackpads perform, and the unique features of its tracking puck. Plus, an interview with the Valve team about the gamepad's design and why they chose its specific components. 

Steam Controller: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/steamcontroller
Disclosure: This product was sent to us by the manufacturer for purposes of review and is not sponsored. 

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
